meals.sidebarTitle: Meal Plan (3 Buffet Meals a Day)
meals.heroHeading: A Balanced, Nutritious Menu for Taste and Health
meals.heroDesc: In a large, rigorously hygienic kitchen, expert Korean chefs and local chefs prepare a variety of fresh Korean, Filipino, and fusion dishes, served as a full buffet three times a day.
checklist: Self-serve buffet for all 3 daily meals
Traditional World Cuisine Day every Thursday
Seasonal tropical fruit served every evening
meals.lunchGalleryTitle: Signature Lunch Menu Gallery (9 Sets Total)
meals.lunchGallerySubtitle: Nutritious main dishes, warm soup, and a variety of side dishes to recharge after class
meals.dinnerGalleryTitle: Signature Dinner Menu Gallery (9 Sets Total)
meals.dinnerGallerySubtitle: Hearty meat dishes and fresh fruit to enjoy after a full day — BBQ parties, pork cutlets, braised short ribs, and more
meals.breakfastHeading: A Light, Healthy Way to Start the Day
meals.breakfastDesc: Every morning you can freely choose from freshly cooked rice with warm soup, soft nutritious vegetable porridge, a toast corner (bread, strawberry jam, butter, cheese), corn cereal with fresh milk, morning rolls, and seasonal fruit — everything you need for an energetic start to the day.
meals.globalDayHeading: Every Thursday: Traditional Food Day (Multicultural Exchange Special)
meals.globalDayDesc: Reflecting our global campus where students from Korea, Japan, Taiwan, Vietnam, Mongolia, Russia and more live together, every Thursday we serve a special buffet featuring each country's signature traditional dishes. It's a popular program where students get to taste each other's food cultures and naturally chat with friends in English over a meal.
meals.fruitHeading: Unlimited Fresh Tropical Fruit, Every Day
meals.fruitDesc: Enjoy an abundance of sweet, locally grown fresh fruit every evening at the buffet — including mango (Carabao mango), pineapple, papaya, sweet banana, and refreshing watermelon.
meals.weeklyHeading: Standard Weekly Menu Guide (1-Week Sample Cycle)
meals.weeklyNote: Menus may vary depending on ingredient availability
safetyBullets: Only safe water passed through a cooking-water filtration system is used.
Kitchen tools like knives, cutting boards, and cloths are color-coded by meat/seafood/vegetable and sanitized at high temperature.
Fresh ingredients are delivered every morning and used the same day as a standard practice.
Students with specific food allergies (peanuts, shellfish, etc.) can inform their manager before the program starts to receive alternative menu options.

activities.heroHeading: Immersive Study on Weekdays, Unforgettable Cebu Adventures on Weekends
activities.heroDesc: Activities help release the study stress that builds up during the week, while giving you the chance to use English in real situations with multinational friends and create memories you'll treasure for life.
activities.heroBoxNote: Register at the campus info desk
checklist: Dedicated Korean manager accompanies every trip
Round-trip transport via the academy's private shuttle van
Underwater GoPro filming with photos provided
Real English communication with multinational friends
safetyBullets: Life vests and helmets are mandatory for all marine and extreme activities.
In case of severe weather or typhoons, schedules may be postponed or refunded for student safety.
Please confirm you have overseas travel insurance before departure.
Designated meeting and return times must be strictly followed; individual departure from the group is not permitted.

tours.title: Oslob Whale Shark Tour
tours.location: Oslob, South Cebu (approx. 3 hrs by academy vehicle)
tours.desc: Held in Oslob, about a 3-hour drive from downtown Cebu or Mactan. Snorkel in emerald-blue waters and observe massive 5-10 meter whale sharks up close — a signature experience found almost nowhere else in the world.
highlights: The world's only up-close wild whale shark snorkeling
Combined with the stunning Tumalog Falls, said to have inspired scenes in Avatar
Dedicated underwater GoPro filming included
Accompanied by a Korean tour manager, with private air-conditioned van transport
tours.schedule: Held biweekly on Saturday or Sunday / Register at the academy office 3 days in advance

tours.title: Island Hopping & Snorkeling Tour
tours.location: Mactan Marine National Park (Hilutungan, Nalusuan Islands)
tours.desc: The most popular marine leisure activity in Cebu, blessed with pristine natural scenery and clear emerald waters. Ride a traditional Filipino bangka boat out to unspoiled waters to see tropical fish and colorful coral reefs, then enjoy a hearty seafood BBQ and tropical fruit on board.
highlights: Snorkel among thousands of tropical fish in a marine protected area
Fresh charcoal-grilled ribs and tiger shrimp seafood lunch served on board
Onboard hand-line fishing and photo time at an emerald sandbar
Beginner-friendly with 1:1 water safety care from a dedicated local helper
tours.schedule: Held every Saturday / Open to all ages

tours.title: Kawasan Extreme Canyoneering
tours.location: Kawasan Falls, Badian (approx. 3.5 hrs by academy vehicle)
tours.desc: A dynamic extreme adventure held at Kawasan Falls, about 4 hours from downtown Cebu. Ranked as one of the world's top 3 canyoneering spots, you'll dive, climb, and slide along natural rock-carved waterways through dramatic primeval canyons, soaking in nature's raw energy.
highlights: 3-12 meter graduated cliff jumps on one of the world's top 3 canyoneering routes
Natural canyon water slides and body rafting
Safety helmet, buoyant life vest, and 2 dedicated professional local guides
Views of the emerald 3-tier Kawasan Falls plus a local buffet meal
tours.schedule: Ages 12+ only / Water shoes and rash guard required

tours.title: Fort San Pedro & Heritage Tour
tours.location: Downtown Cebu City (20 min by academy vehicle)
tours.desc: Built in 1565, Fort San Pedro is the oldest triangular stone fort in the Philippines. It served as a base for Cebu's independence movement in the late Spanish colonial era, US military barracks during the American colonial period, and a POW camp under Japanese occupation — a historic heritage site that embodies the Philippines' modern history.
highlights: Spanish Renaissance military architecture and antique stone walls
Visit the Cebu history relics museum and archival exhibits
Atmospheric photos in the quiet Spanish-style garden
A walking stroll through Colon Street, downtown Cebu's historic culture strip
tours.schedule: A light city-walk option for weekday afternoons after class or Sunday afternoons

tours.title: Magellan's Cross & Santo Niño Basilica
tours.location: Cebu City Hall Plaza (20 min by academy vehicle)
tours.desc: Erected in 1521 by Portuguese navigator Magellan when he landed in the Philippines during his circumnavigation, this cross is said to grant miracles and draws countless pilgrims; it's encased in a tindalo wood cover to prevent damage. Together with the nearby Santo Niño Basilica, famous for its statue of the infant Jesus, it is considered a sacred site of Philippine faith.
highlights: A UNESCO-listed historic site marking the start of Catholic missionary work in the Philippines
View the 16th-century mural of Magellan's landing preserved on the octagonal pavilion ceiling
Experience the traditional candle prayer ritual (with Sinulog dancers) for health and longevity
A pilgrimage through the 450-year-old Santo Niño Basilica
tours.schedule: Located downtown, easily combined with shopping at Ayala Mall

tours.title: Cebu City & Heritage Highlights Tour
tours.location: Cebu City & nearby areas (by academy vehicle)
tours.desc: A full-day city tour covering Cebu's must-see highlights, from downtown to the outskirts. From the lively local atmosphere of a traditional market to a grand pilgrimage site and a night-view lookout over the whole city — experience the many faces of Cebu in a single day.
highlights: Explore the vibrant local market scene at Carbon Market
Pilgrimage at Simala Shrine, famed for its striking golden architecture
Admire the grand Greek-inspired architecture of Temple of Leah
Sunset & night views of Cebu City from the Tops Cebu lookout
tours.schedule: Held 1-2 times a month / A full-day itinerary due to travel distance

tours.title: Cebu Water World Park
tours.location: Mandaue City (approx. 15 min by academy vehicle)
tours.duration: Half-day or full-day (departs 10:00 AM, returns 4:30 PM)
tours.desc: The largest and most popular water park in Cebu, conveniently close to campus. With 10 giant extreme water slides, various rides, a relaxing 200-meter lazy river, and a wave pool, it's the perfect place to blow off steam with friends on the weekend.
highlights: 10 thrilling giant high-speed water slides
A relaxing 200-meter Lazy River and a mega wave pool
A dedicated kids' aqua play zone
Just 15 minutes from campus — an easy, low-hassle getaway
tours.schedule: Open every weekend / Special group discount with student ID

tours.title: SM Seaside Ice Skating Rink
tours.location: 3rd Floor, SM Seaside City Cebu (approx. 20 min by academy vehicle)
tours.desc: The only Olympic-size ice rink in the Visayas-Mindanao region — a refreshingly cool escape from the Philippine heat. Even first-timers can safely enjoy the ice with polar bear skate aids and dedicated coaching, making it a favorite indoor activity.
highlights: The only Olympic-size (30×60m) ice rink in the Visayas-Mindanao region
Polar bear skate aids and a skating coach available for beginners
A comfortably air-conditioned indoor venue — no worries about the heat
Located inside SM Seaside Mall, easy to combine with shopping and dining
tours.schedule: Held biweekly on Sunday afternoons / Skate rental included

visa.heading: Philippine Study Abroad Essential Documents (SSP & Visa)

items.title: 1. SSP (Special Study Permit)
items.desc: Under Philippine immigration law, this is the official permit any foreigner entering on a tourist visa must obtain to legally study English. Regardless of program length, SYA arranges issuance during your first week in the Philippines; it's valid for 6 months. (Cost: 6,800 PHP)

items.title: 2. 30-Day Visa-Free Entry & Visa Extension
items.desc: Korean nationals automatically receive 30-day visa-free entry to the Philippines. Students staying beyond 4 weeks (8/12/16 weeks, etc.) must extend their visa in 30-day increments through Philippine immigration; SYA's administration handles all extension procedures, so you never need to visit immigration yourself.

items.title: 3. ACR I-Card (Alien Registration)
items.desc: A mandatory ID card for any foreigner staying 59+ days in the Philippines (at the 2nd extension point for 8-week students). Valid for 1 year upon issuance. (Cost: 3,500 PHP)

visa.warning: Attendance Below 80% = Visa Warning: Under Philippine immigration regulations, your SSP permit may be revoked if your official attendance rate falls below 80%. SYA's academic management system closely monitors attendance to help you avoid this.

pickup.heading: Airport Arrival & Safe Pickup Guide

cards.title: SYA Signboard Waiting at the Arrival Gate
bullets: After collecting your luggage and exiting through international arrivals, an SYA staff member holding a signboard will be waiting for you.
A Korean staff member or dedicated driver will safely guide you to the private pickup vehicle.
The ride from the airport to the SYA Cebu campus takes about 25-30 minutes.

cards.title: Terminal 1 Domestic Arrivals Meeting Point
bullets: For domestic connections via Manila or elsewhere, we'll wait at the agreed spot in front of the domestic arrivals gate.
Let us know your flight number and connection time in advance via KakaoTalk for a tailored pickup.
Even for late-night or early-morning arrivals, we safely guide you through 24-hour dormitory check-in.

pickup.hotlineDesc: If your flight is delayed or canceled, message us immediately via the KakaoTalk channel SYA_ACADEMY or our emergency contact — we'll check real-time flight schedules and ensure a smooth pickup regardless of delays.

localLife.heading: Philippines Local Living Cost & Allowance Guide

cards.label: Recommended Monthly Allowance (weekends included)
cards.note: Cafes, dining out, shopping, massages, etc.

cards.label: Currency Exchange Tip
cards.note: Instant peso withdrawal at local ATMs

bullets: 3 Daily Meals Included: Since all 3 daily Korean-style buffet meals are provided free on weekdays and weekends alike, your personal allowance mainly goes toward weekend activities (island hopping, massages, cafes) or personal essentials.

Local Healthcare: Major Cebu general hospitals (Chong Hua Hospital, UC Med) and Korean-speaking clinics are located right near campus. If you purchase overseas student insurance before departure, medical costs can be fully claimed.
